test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-5) Official Paper (Held On: 15 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Five students A, B, C, D and E study in different schools K, L, M, N and O, but not necessarily in the same order. Each one likes only one subject, viz., Hindi, Mathematics, Science, Social Science and English. C studies in M. B does not like Social Science. D likes English and studies in N. The student of L likes Math. E likes Hindi but is neither from O nor L. B studies in O.

Which one of the following students studies in school L and likes Mathematics?
solution:
**Given:**

 
• Number of students:5, namely A, B, C, D and E.
 
• Number of schools:5, namely K, L, M, N and O.
 
• Number of subjects:5, namely Hindi, Mathematics, Science, Social Science and English

**Explanation :**

 
• C studies in M
 
• D likes English and studies in N. 
 
• B studies in O and does not like Social Science.
